pinRationale: Pinned to HEAD at the time this matrix was hardened. Gradle 9.7.1 runs natively on a JDK-21 runner (no discovery fallback needed). Smallest/simplest repo in the matrix: no explicit JDK config anywhere, so jdkVersion falls all the way through to the AGP-minimum-JDK floor.
groundTruthMethod: gradleVersion/androidSdkVersion/moduleCount were confirmed by reading build files at the pinned commit (no multi-segment includes here, so no implicit-parent surprises). jdkVersion and androidBuildToolsVersion/androidNdkVersion are AGP's own deterministic resolution, not literal build-file values — confirmed by running `gradlezilla generate --dry-run --format json` against this exact pinned checkout twice: once with no Android SDK present at all, once with a full local SDK. Both runs produced byte-identical values for these fields, proving they are a function of the pinned AGP/Gradle version, not of whatever happens to be installed on the runner.

jdkVersion.source: verified run: extractionMetadata.jdkVersionSource="agpMinimum" — no explicit sourceCompatibility/targetCompatibility/jvmTarget/toolchain anywhere in timber/build.gradle, timber-lint/build.gradle, timber-sample/build.gradle, or root build.gradle; AGP 9.4.0 (gradle/libs.versions.toml agp="9.4.0") requires JDK 17+, which resolves

androidSdkVersion.source: gradle/libs.versions.toml: compileSdk = "36", read via libs.versions.compileSdk.get() in timber/build.gradle

androidBuildToolsVersion.source: verified run: not set anywhere in build.gradle files; this is AGP 9.4.0's own default build-tools version

moduleCount.source: settings.gradle: include ':timber', include ':timber-lint', include ':timber-sample' — no multi-segment includes, confirmed by verified run

ndkPresent.source: verified run: androidNdkVersion="28.2.13676358" — AGP 9.x auto-resolves a default NDK version even though this project has zero native code (no externalNativeBuild/CMakeLists.txt anywhere); this is AGP-version-dependent behavior (see now-in-android.json), not something driven by this project's own config
